datasheet.title: LMR70503 SIMPLE SWITCHER® Buck-Boost Converter For Negative Output Voltage in µSMD

notes: The downloaded PDF still titles the package microSMD; its features identify the 8-bump thin DSBGA package.
VREF is a reference output loaded by RREF, not the voltage regulated at the FB pin. FB is compared to ground.
The 500 kHz typical entry describes minimum switching frequency, not a fixed switching frequency.
The 0.32 A typical limit is peak switch current, not guaranteed output current. The private simulation adapter does not establish datasheet-equivalent timing.

input_voltage.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

output_voltage.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

operating_junction_temperature.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

input_voltage_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

output_voltage_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

junction_temperature_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

storage_temperature.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

reference_output_voltage.conditions: VIN = 3.3 V, VOUT = -5 V, VEN = 1.8 V; typical at TJ = 25 degC, bold limits over TJ = -40 to 125 degC. RREF = 100 kOhm to GND.

minimum_switching_frequency.conditions: VIN = 3.3 V, VOUT = -5 V, VEN = 1.8 V; typical at TJ = 25 degC, bold limits over TJ = -40 to 125 degC.

switch_current_limit.conditions: VIN = 3.3 V, VOUT = -5 V, VEN = 1.8 V; typical at TJ = 25 degC, bold limits over TJ = -40 to 125 degC.
switch_current_limit.notes: Internally trimmed limit; actual application peak depends on VIN, inductance and junction temperature (footnote 3).

quiescent_current.conditions: VIN = 3.3 V, VOUT = -5 V, VEN = 1.8 V; typical at TJ = 25 degC, bold limits over TJ = -40 to 125 degC. VIN = 5.5 V instead of 3.3 V, no switching.

shutdown_current.conditions: VIN = 3.3 V, VOUT = -5 V, VEN = 1.8 V; typical at TJ = 25 degC, bold limits over TJ = -40 to 125 degC. VIN = 5.5 V instead of 3.3 V, EN = 0 V.

switch_on_resistance.conditions: VIN = 2.8 V, VOUT = -5 V, VEN = 1.8 V, TJ = 25 degC; both resistance entries use standard type and apply at 25 degC only.

thermal_shutdown_temperature.conditions: Junction temperature rising; typical thermal shutdown threshold.
